T: One last ride. One last feast.
D: The Guardians race to save Rocket's life and face the scientist who made him.
P: Serve the mains when the Guardians land on Counter-Earth.
S: Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with chilli oil and soy sauce
Pork and cabbage dumplings pan-fried until crisp underneath, steamed with a splash of water, chilli oil to dip.
vintage cheese and butter dough cut into little bones, baked crisp and golden with paprika

Sharp cheddar and butter crackers cut into little dog bone shapes, baked crisp and golden with a pinch of paprika. Pulse 200g grated vintage cheddar, 80g cold butter, 150g plain flour, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of salt in a food processor until crumbly, then add 2 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Chill for 30 minutes. Roll out 4mm thick and cut into dog bone shapes. Bake on lined trays at 180C for 12 minutes until golden and crisp, then cool on the tray.
Rocket's smoky roasted chickpeas and nuts
Crunchy roasted chickpeas and peanuts with smoked paprika and garlic

Roasted chickpeas and peanuts tossed with smoked paprika and garlic, baked at 200C until crunchy. Drain and dry 2 cans of chickpeas. Toss with 150g peanuts, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder and salt. Roast at 200C for 30 minutes, shaking the tray, until crunchy. Cool and pile into a bowl. Do not call them trash snacks.
M: smashed patties, melted cheddar, pickles and sauce, oven chips, on a copy of our planet

Smashed beef patties with melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato, pickles and burger sauce in toasted buns, with crisp oven fries. Bake 1kg frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes. Divide 600g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash each flat onto a very hot greased pan, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, top with a cheddar slice and cook 1 minute more. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp chopped pickles for the sauce. Toast 4 buns, then stack 2 patties each with lettuce, tomato, pickles and sauce.
Orgocorp crackling pork belly with mash
Crackling roast pork belly with apple sauce and buttery mashed potatoes

Pork belly slow roasted at 160C for 3 hours, crackling blasted crisp, sliced over mash with apple sauce. Score a 1.5kg pork belly, rub with salt and dry overnight. Roast at 160C for 3 hours, then blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles. Simmer chopped apples with a little water into sauce. Slice the pork over buttery mash from 1kg potatoes.
W: Chocolate cake with fudge icing, sprinkles and one little candle

Chocolate cake baked at 175C for 35 minutes, covered in fudge icing and sprinkles, a little candle on top. Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, then 3 eggs. Fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake at 175C for 35 minutes. Cover with fudge icing of butter, icing sugar and cocoa, then sprinkles and one little candle on top.
K: Ginger beer with lime and bitters, dark rum floated on top

Dark rum poured over ginger beer and fresh lime with a dash of bitters, tall over ice with a fat wedge of lime. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze the juice of half a lime into each and add a dash of bitters. Pour in 150ml ginger beer, then gently float 45ml dark rum over the top of each so it clouds down through the glass. Garnish with a lime wedge and a piece of crystallised ginger. For a booze-free version, skip the rum and add more ginger beer.

dishes.n: Orgocorp crackling pork belly with mash
dishes.make_ahead: Pork can be salted a day ahead

steps.text: Score the skin and rub with salt, then dry in the fridge overnight if you can.
Roast at 160C until tender.
Blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Simmer the apples with water into a sauce.
Slice the pork and serve over the mash with apple sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Tofu can be pressed and marinated a day ahead

ingredients.item: extra firm tofu, cut into 4 slabs

steps.text: Press the tofu dry and marinate in the soy and smoked paprika.
Dip the rice paper in water, wrap two sheets around each tofu slab and brush with the oil.
Roast at 230C, turning once, until the rice paper puffs and blisters like crackling. Sprinkle with the salt flakes.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes and mash with butter.
Simmer the apples with the water into a sauce.
Slice the tofu and serve over the mash with apple sauce.
Beat the butter with the sugar, then the eggs.
Fold in the flour, cocoa and milk and pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 175C and cool completely.
Beat a fudge icing from extra butter, icing sugar and cocoa and spread over the cake.
Top with sprinkles and one little candle.

af.make_ahead: Steep, sweeten and chill the dark tea up to 2 days ahead; build the glasses to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 5 minutes, lift out, stir in the molasses and vanilla and chill.
Fill tall glasses with ice, squeeze lime juice into each and top with ginger beer.
Float 45ml of the dark tea over the top so it clouds down through the glass.
Garnish with a lime wedge and crystallised ginger.
